node.statement: For overlapping original charts centered at V and W, write Psi_V for the unchanged source graph parametrization after its affine-linear coordinate transport and write pi_W for the unchanged target anti-Hermitian coordinate projection after the inverse affine-linear transport. On the original overlap the transition is pi_W composed with Psi_V. Its domain is open because the already-supplied C^1 graph charts are charts, and it is smooth because Psi_V uses the now-proved-smooth unchanged g_V while all transports and projections are affine-linear; interchanging V and W gives the smooth inverse. Thus the original cover and the original chart maps form a smooth compatible atlas. No underlying point, graph function, chart map, or first derivative has been replaced: the preceding child identifies each smooth graph function with the original C^1 function, and the remaining maps are exactly the old affine-linear ones.
